content: 1. Begin the T'ai Chi form by initiating the sequence, referred to as The Beginning of T'ai Chi or The Preparation Form (太極起式). 2. Raise your hands into position, known as Raise Hands Above Posture or simply Raise Hands (提手上勢). 3. Perform the movement called Hand Plays P'i P'a, which is also referred to as Play Guitar or Hand Strums the Lute (手揮琵琶). 4. Execute the technique Grasp Bird's Tail (攬雀尾). 5. Transition into the posture Single Whip (單鞭). 6. Perform the Slant Flying Posture, also known as Slant Single Whip or Flying Oblique (斜飛勢 or 斜單鞭). 7. Repeat the Raise Hands Above Posture (提手上勢). 8. Move into White Crane Spreads Wings, also called White Stork Flaps its Wings (白鶴亮翅). 9. Perform Brush Knee Push Step on the left and right sides four times, also known as Brush Knee Twist Step (摟膝拗步左右四度). 10. Repeat Hand Plays P'i P'a (手揮琵琶). 11. Step forward and execute Deflect, Parry, Punch, also called Step Up Diverting and Blocking Fist (進步搬攔捶). 12. Perform the movement As If Seemingly Sealed Shut, also referred to as Push Forward or As if Closing Up (如封似閉 or 進按). 13. Transition into Carry Tiger to the Mountain, also known as Tiger and Leopard Spring to the Mountain (抱虎歸山). 14. Cross your hands in the posture Cross Hands (十字手). 15. Execute Slant Brush Knee Push Step (斜摟膝拗步). 16. Turn your body and perform Brush Knee Push Step (轉身摟膝拗步). 17. Repeat the movement Grasp Bird's Tail (攬雀尾). 18. Perform Single Whip, which can also be referred to as Slant Single Whip (單鞭 or 斜單鞭). 19. Transition into Fist Under Elbow Punch (肘底看捶). 20. Execute Fall to Repulse Monkey on the left and right sides three times (倒攆猴左右三度). 21. Perform the Slant Flying Posture (斜飛勢). 22. Repeat the Raise Hands Above Posture (提手上勢). 23. Move into White Crane Spreads Wings (白鶴亮翅). 24. Perform Brush Knee Push Step (摟膝拗步). 25. Transition into Sea Bottom Needle, also called Needle at the Bottom of the Sea (海底針). 26. Execute Fan Through Back, also referred to as Play Arms like a Fan (扇通背). 27. Rotate your body and perform Away Body Punch, also known as Strike Fist to Back or Parry and Punch (翻身撇身捶). 28. Step back and execute Deflect, Parry, Punch, also called Move Step Diverting and Blocking Punch (退步搬攔捶). 29. Step up and perform Grasp Bird's Tail (上步攬雀尾). 30. Transition into Single Whip (單鞭). 31. Perform Cloud Hands three times (雲手三度). 32. Repeat Single Whip (單鞭). 33. Execute Left High Pat Horse (左高探馬). 34. Perform Right Separate Foot Kick, also called Right Parting Leg (右分腳). 35. Transition into Right High Pat Horse (右高探馬). 36. Execute Left Separate Foot Kick, also called Left Parting Leg (左分腳). 37. Turn your body and perform Kick with Heel, also referred to as Turn Body Pedalling Foot (轉身蹬腿). 38. Perform Brush Knee Push Step twice (摟膝拗步二度). 39. Step forward and execute Punch Down (進步栽捶). 40. Rotate your body and perform Away Body Punch (翻身撇身捶). 41. Transition into High Pat Horse (高探馬). 42. Execute Right Separate Hands (右分手). 43. Perform the First Raise Foot Kick (一起腳). 44. Step back into Seven Stars (退步七星). 45. Transition into Step Back Hit Tiger Posture, also called Retreat Step Beat the Tiger (退步打虎勢). 46. Perform the Second Raise Foot Kick (二起腳). 47. Execute Double Peaks Pierce Ears, also referred to as Strike the Ears with Double Fists (雙峰貫耳). 48. Lean back and perform Kick with Toe, also called Open Body and Kick (披身踢腿). 49. Turn your body and execute Kick with Heel (轉身蹬腿). 50. Transition into High Pat Horse (高探馬). 51. Step forward and perform Deflect, Parry, Punch (進步搬攔捶). 52. Repeat As If Seemingly Sealed Shut (如封似閉 or 進按). 53. Transition into Carry Tiger to the Mountain (抱虎歸山). 54. Cross your hands in the posture Cross Hands (十字手). 55. Execute Slant Brush Knee Push Step (斜摟膝拗步). 56. Turn your body and perform Brush Knee Push Step (轉身摟膝拗步). 57. Repeat Grasp Bird's Tail (攬雀尾). 58. Perform Single Whip, also referred to as Slant Single Whip (單鞭 or 斜單鞭). 59. Repeat Hand Plays P'i P'a (手揮琵琶). 60. Execute Wild Horse Separate Mane, also called Parting the Wild Horse's Mane (野馬分鬃). 61. Repeat Hand Plays P'i P'a (手揮琵琶). 62. Perform Wild Horse Separate Mane three times (野馬分鬃三度). 63. Repeat Hand Plays P'i P'a (手揮琵琶). 64. Execute Wild Horse Separate Mane (野馬分鬃). 65. Transition into Jade Lady Works Shuttles twice, also called Jade Girl Works at the Shuttle (玉女穿梭二度). 66. Repeat Hand Plays P'i P'a (手揮琵琶). 67. Perform Wild Horse Separate Mane (野馬分鬃). 68. Repeat Jade Lady Works Shuttles twice (玉女穿梭二度). 69. Execute Grasp Bird's Tail (攬雀尾). 70. Transition into Single Whip (單鞭). 71. Perform Cloud Hands three times (雲手三度). 72. Repeat Single Whip (單鞭). 73. Transition into Downward Posture, also known as Snake Creeps Down Posture (下勢 or 蛇身下勢). 74. Perform Left Golden Rooster on One Leg, also called Golden Cockerel Standing on One Leg (左金雞獨立). 75. Execute Right Golden Rooster on One Leg (右金雞獨立). 76. Perform Fall to Repulse Monkey on the left and right sides three times (倒攆猴左右三度). 77. Transition into Cross Slant Flying Posture (橫斜飛勢). 78. Repeat the Raise Hands Above Posture (提手上勢). 79. Move into White Crane Spreads Wings (白鶴亮翅). 80. Perform Brush Knee Push Step (摟膝拗步). 81. Transition into Sea Bottom Needle (海底針). 82. Execute Fan Through Back (扇通背). 83. Rotate your body and perform Away Body Punch (翻身撇身捶). 84. Step up and execute Deflect, Parry, Punch (上步搬攔捶). 85. Step up and perform Grasp Bird's Tail (上步攬雀尾). 86. Transition into Single Whip (單鞭). 87. Perform Cloud Hands three times (雲手三度). 88. Repeat Single Whip (單鞭). 89. Execute High Pat Horse (高探馬). 90. Perform Slap Face Palm, also called Palm Goes to Meet the Face (撲面掌). 91. Rotate your body and execute Single Swing Lotus, also referred to as Turn Body Cross Swing Lotus (翻身單擺蓮). 92. Perform Brush Knee Push Step (摟膝拗步). 93. Step up and execute Finger Stop Punch, also called Pointing to the Crotch Punch (上步指擋捶). 94. Step up and perform Grasp Bird's Tail (上步攬雀尾). 95. Transition into Single Whip (單鞭). 96. Perform Downward Posture, also known as Snake Creeps Down Posture (下勢 or 蛇身下勢). 97. Step up into Seven Stars (上步七星). 98. Step back and execute Ride Tiger (退步跨虎). 99. Rotate your body and perform Slap Face Palm, also called Turn Body Hit Face Palm (轉身撲面掌). 100. Rotate your body and execute Double Swing Lotus, also referred to as Turn Body Double Swing Lotus (翻身雙擺蓮). 101. Perform Bend Bow Shoot Tiger, also called Curve Bow Shoot Tiger (彎弓射虎). 102. Transition into High Pat Horse (高探馬). 103. Execute Slap Face Palm (撲面掌). 104. Rotate your body and perform Away Body Punch (翻身撇身捶). 105. Step up and execute High Pat Horse (上步高探馬). 106. Step up and perform Grasp Bird's Tail (上步攬雀尾). 107. Transition into Single Whip (單鞭). 108. Conclude the T'ai Chi sequence with Conclusion of T'ai Chi, also called Closing T'ai Chi (合太極).
